fields.label: Fact
fields.description: One coherent verbatim quotation from this row's source. Preserve complete sentences and original wording; put interpretation on the parent Signal.

fields.label: Source URL
fields.description: Exact source URL for this fact. Open and verify this page; do not use a search result, reconstructed URL, or unrelated company page.

fields.label: Source Date
fields.description: Publication or observation date for this fact, when available.

fields.label: Evidence Basis
fields.description: Classify this fact only: Observed when directly stated in the cited source; Inferred when it is a conclusion drawn from indirect evidence.
